_comment: Test presets for the optional KVMem long-context mode. workspace is the logical context kept mostly in host RAM. gpuBudget+genReserve is the VRAM KV working pool (same 16384-token pool as the 16K profile, so VRAM need is comparable). hostKvMiB is the hard KVMem host-KV quota, containerRamMiB the hard container cap (swap disabled). Nothing here is measured on an RX 6800.
